patch_description: Uses a permutation-equivariant collective phase-echo ansatz instead of independently parameterizing each qubit. Every block alternates three complete-graph CZ twists with noncommuting collective RX/RY mixers. Conjugating collective mixers through complete-graph CZ layers generates high-order graph correlations aligned with the 28 pairwise input features. The final RY layer makes phase information visible to Z readout, while tying the two echo rotations regularizes the model. This retains only three parameters per block—20 total including readout—while providing substantially more interaction depth than the previous single-twist collective ansatz.
